summary: When broken_gates' terminal exec diagnostic test times out waiting for its stuck gate, it now prints the step's status and every observation of the exec, with store index, time, status, exit code and incarnation, so a CI failure says which half of the diagnostic was missing.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to time out with only the label again.
